title: The Effects of Light Reduction on Retinopathy of Prematurity (Light-ROP)
brief_summary: To evaluate the effect of ambient light reduction on the incidence of retinopathy of prematurity (ROP).
raw_criteria: Premature infants weighing less than 1,251 grams at birth and having a gestational age of less than 31 weeks were eligible for randomization. Consent must have been obtained within 24 hours of birth. Patients with major congenital anomalies are excluded.
